design: no new subsystem: the existing broker records the last real upstream outcome per provider as it serves normal traffic, so /status can report evidence instead of configuration. No probe is ever fired to render a badge.
quotaCost: 0 extra requests; evidence is a by-product of requests that were already being made

liveStatusResponse.groq: CONFIGURED -> COMPLETION_VERIFIED after one real call
liveStatusResponse.githubModels: CONFIGURED -> CONTRACT_VIOLATION after one real attempt

backCompatibility: existing `providers` booleans kept unchanged; `states` added alongside
toolCallingClaimPolicy: TOOL_CALLING_VERIFIED is set only when a real response body contains a tool_calls entry; a text completion can never produce it (pinned by test)
credentialLeakCheck: status payload asserted free of the credential in tests
